context: The installed caller already matches the requested cadence, mode, profile, and pin. This scenario tests that a re-run is idempotent, that the agent says so rather than rewriting a file to look productive, and that it can give a correct removal procedure, including removing the Action's required check from branch protection before or with deleting the workflow.

checklist.name: Caller workflow unchanged
checklist.description: .github/workflows/tessl-code-review.yml is byte-identical to the version provided in the inputs

checklist.name: No second caller created
checklist.description: Exactly one file under .github/workflows/ contains a step using tesslio/code-review, and no additional workflow file was added

checklist.name: Summary reports that nothing changed
checklist.description: summary.md states plainly that the existing workflow already matched the intent and that this run changed nothing, rather than describing edits that were not made

checklist.name: Summary describes the installed contract
checklist.description: summary.md states the cadence (a review on every push, in-flight run superseded), that findings block, the standard profile, and the pinned revision

checklist.name: Removal deletes the caller workflow
checklist.description: removal.md instructs the maintainer to delete .github/workflows/tessl-code-review.yml

checklist.name: Removal covers the repository secret
checklist.description: removal.md instructs the maintainer to delete the TESSL_TOKEN repository secret if nothing else uses it

checklist.name: Removal names the required check to drop
checklist.description: removal.md instructs the maintainer to remove the required status check named Tessl Code Review from branch protection. Full credit requires that exact name rather than the caller's job name

checklist.name: Removal ordering explained
checklist.description: removal.md states that the required check must be removed before or together with deleting the workflow, because a required check that nothing reports blocks every pull request indefinitely

checklist.name: Removal states what it does not undo
checklist.description: removal.md states that reviews and comments already published stay on their pull requests and are not removed

checklist.name: No unrequested changes
checklist.description: The agent did not modify the runner, timeout, permissions block, triggers, mention guard, or Action inputs, and did not propose adopting a newer release when the task said this pass keeps the current pin
